protocol.earlier_collection: A/B shell and material-static were completed before the profile-warm-up reset and subtotal-parser fixes. Their measured build commands are identical; selected original profiles are reparsed with the corrected parser.
protocol.revision_order: Rotated per repetition; comparisons remain within each cohort/profile.
protocol.host_isolation: Exclusive local agent build slot; emulators stopped. Normal desktop/browser activity remained; no CPU governor or thermal controls were changed.
protocol.target_clean: Root-project build outputs removed; included tooling builds/dependency downloads preserved.
protocol.scope: Monorepo sample app plus its project dependencies; these timings are not the cost of consuming precompiled Maven artifacts.
protocol.warmups: Excluded. Later cohorts reset root outputs before profile warm-up to avoid observed Koin profile-switch stale output; all valid measured series already start target-clean.
protocol.edits: Back content-description and consumed Tabler SVG stroke width; exact source bytes restored with an unmeasured rebuild.
protocol.resource_edit_scope: Only profiles consuming the edited SVG; other cases are N/A, not zero-time samples.
protocol.rss: 100 ms sampled sum of launcher/descendant RSS, including shared pages; not unique resident memory or Java heap.
protocol.timed_interval: Gradle process launch to exit; cleanup, source editing, APK analysis and restoration excluded.
protocol.task_durations: Elapsed Gradle task durations, not CPU time or a partition of total build wall time. Only task rows; project subtotals excluded.
excluded: Failed cache validation (none occurred in selected data)
